title: Price-match / better-offer request
summary: Ask a retailer to match a lower price or refund the difference under its price-match policy.
goal_default: price match or a refund of the difference

rights.claim: Many retailers offer price matching or a post-purchase price adjustment within a set window.
A screenshot or link to the qualifying lower price usually suffices.
rights.basis: Standard evidence a price-match desk accepts.

ladder: Return + rebuy at the lower price

artifact.subject: Price match / price adjustment request
artifact.body:
To: {{target}} Support

Hello,

I found this item at a lower price and would like to request a {{goal}}{{amount_clause}}, per your price-match policy.

I can provide a screenshot / link to the qualifying offer. Please advise how to proceed.

Sincerely,
{{name}}

disclaimer: This is information to help you write your own request. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
